'''Belsus''' was the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gentes/Legends|Gentes]] within the [[Anoat system/Legends|Anoat system]] in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat Sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> The moon was the location of [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] [[Main Rendering Plant 908]], where a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], led by [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Flynn Kybo]], and [[Banvhar Combine|Banvhar]] survivors [[Battle of Belsus|tracked]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] there. Grievous had attempted to establish a laboratory for study of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Flynn Kybo and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[B'dard Tone]] [[Death/Legends|died]] attempting to kill Grievous,<ref name="General Grievous 4">[[General Grievous 4|''General Grievous'' 4]]</ref> who had [[Battle of Gentes|crushed]] all resistance on the planet.<ref name="General Grievous 2">[[General Grievous 2|''General Grievous'' 2]]</ref> Though Grievous escaped,<ref name="General Grievous 4" /> the underground [[City/Legends|cities]] were devastated when the moon's thermal core was destroyed by Kybo.<ref name="TCSWE" />
